title: payout.requested DLQ entry v1
description: One entry of stream:payout.requested.dlq. payout-worker writes it (XADD ... MAXLEN ~ 10000) when it dead-letters a stream:payout.requested message, then XACKs the original. Redis stream fields are strings on the wire; this schema describes the entry after decoding, with delivery_count as an integer. It never contains bank details, names or exception text beyond the redacted summary in error. Sources: README C21, PAY-408, PAY-409.

envelope.description: The original entry's envelope field, unchanged: the payout.requested v1 envelope as a JSON string. It may be empty or invalid JSON when the original entry was malformed (error_code schema_invalid).

source_id.description: The original stream entry ID in stream:payout.requested. A crash between the DLQ XADD and the XACK can leave two DLQ entries with the same source_id.

error_kind.description: invalid: the message can never succeed (dead-lettered at once). payroll: payroll was unreachable or refused the call until the delivery budget ran out. internal: a worker failure (database error or timeout, handler deadline) until the budget ran out.

error_code.description: Machine-readable cause, for example schema_invalid, amount_mismatch, payout_not_found, payroll_unavailable, invalid_token, db_timeout.

error.description: Redacted summary of the exception (deny-listed keys masked); never an amount, account or routing number, token or API key.

delivery_count.description: The delivery number of the message when it was dead-lettered (1 for poison found on the first delivery).

consumer.description: The consumer name (PAYOUT_CONSUMER_NAME, by default the hostname) that dead-lettered the message.

failed_at.description: UTC time of the dead-lettering, RFC 3339 with a Z suffix.
